name: VHS Camcorder
description: A home-video camcorder overlay on your footage: a blocky white PLAY or REC readout, a blinking red dot, a battery icon, a date and time stamp, a tracking-noise band that rolls through, chroma bleed, a warm faded grade and scanlines.
best_use_cases: Home-video looks over your own footage
style: Warm faded grade with red/cyan chroma bleed and scanlines, VT323 on-screen display (PLAY/REC/REW, battery, date, running clock), a rolling tracking band with a horizontal tear, and a REW rewind with streaks and a backwards clock. Tape hiss and motor hum underneath.
